# Locust Harvest

> Locust Harvest (Pty) Ltd is a technology and innovation company building digital platforms for real-world problems — home to NOVELTY — daily statistical sports picks — and the Plague2Profit philosophy.

## Platforms

- [NOVELTY](https://www.locustharvest.com/#novelty): Daily statistical sports predictions and analysis for football, across dozens of leading leagues.
- [Plague2Profit](https://www.locustharvest.com/#plague2profit): Our philosophy, media and social ecosystem — turning challenges into opportunities.
- [The Daily Harvest](https://www.locustharvest.com/harvest/): Transparent public archive of every prediction.
